artist_direction: Preserve Luis M. Minier's own geometric hand-drawn face construction, expressive brows, individual mouths/noses, slight asymmetry; finished clean 2D animation with modest anime polish, not generic anime.
visual: mature hand-drawn-derived 2D cel animated comic, clean confident outlines, graphic grouped shadow masses, painterly accents, warm/cool contrast, dark natural skin values intact
negative: text, letters, words, captions, signage, wall writing, graffiti slogans, logos, watermark, floating quotes, speech bubbles, shiny generic anime eyes, generic face, photorealism, 3d plastic skin, over-sketching, extra arms, malformed hands, duplicate character
quality_gate: Human inspection required: author recognizability, correct face/hair/body, age, costume, hands, background text, composition, readable silhouette, character continuity.
